caption: Look inside the culture before asking it to answer an immune question. This invented epithelial example retains selected cells, omits immune and stromal neighbors, and treats deliberate additions as a new experiment. Specialized retention is method-specific; organization is not complete tissue or host immunity.
alt: Three schematic cards trace a mixed source specimen to a selected epithelial organoid in matrix and then an optional co-culture. Blue round epithelial cells organize around a lumen; rose immune cells and gold spindle-shaped stromal cells are missing from the pictured epithelial culture. Separate added immune and stromal cells enter a new experiment. Shapes and counts are invented, not measured composition. Self-organization does not recreate complete tissue, host immunity or rank model performance.
